text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My childhood dream
was to come in first place in footraces.

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ecchan, you're so slooow!
I'm gonna go on ahead, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I never managed to catch up to her, not even once. That tail-bearing friend of mine completely shattered both my pride and the limits of human capability.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I win!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was furious. To think there's an insurmountable wall simply because I'm human...
How could such an absurdity be allowed to exist?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so,
her running was more beautiful than anything—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a young child, I innocently believed
that she was the fastest, the strongest, and the most beautiful of all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though I wanted to believe.

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: Is it true... that you're quitting the Kids' Race Club?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because I promised my mom that if
I didn't make the club representative in yesterday's selection race,
I'd quit...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ecchan, after you cheered me on the whole time... I'm so sorry I couldn't make the team...

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text:
B-But still!
You've won first place plenty of times, haven't you?
You only came in second this time...!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text:
The girl chosen as the representative was certainly strong.
She often takes first place in big races, too... But I still think you're stronger, truly!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Her results are pretty inconsistent.
Finishing off the board isn't all that rare for her.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even I have times where I think...
I'm actually stronger than her!
But, but...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The winner yesterday was her!
...When it really counts, she's seriously strong. So I just have to accept it, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The other kids in the club, the teachers too...
They all recognize her as our representative.
Everyone thinks so!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...My mom was originally against
me racing in the first place.
So if I'm not number one in the club, I can't keep going."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't win yesterday!
...So it's all over now...!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-Wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I knew it.
She truly is strong.
Even though I, of all people, should know best.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time I challenged her, I was overwhelmed, crushed, jealous,
obsessed, and studied her, until I realized I could never win.
Precisely because that's who I am—I understand, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if the representative selection race
wasn't just a one-time opportunity?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like, if it were like pro baseball, where whoever
plays lots of matches and wins the most takes the championship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it over and over again—
in the end, I truly believed right up to the very last
that she was the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (...That is why. That is precisely why.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Hello to everyone watching our special broadcast!
I'm Otonashi from Monthly Twinkle."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This broadcast is being relayed and streamed
across various media platforms.
As for the internet broadcast—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, it's starting!
It's so cool that they stream stuff like this on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"They said on TV and online
that there's a huge announcement, but... what could it be?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing by the front of the station, I noticed a crowd gathering for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, they're showing something on the big screen by the station.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You mean that one, right?
The one that took up a full page in the sports newspaper saying there'd be a major announcement today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the one advertised in racing magazines too!
Feels like every magazine I look at lately has an ad for this.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Well then, without further ado, let's get down to business.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I, Etsuko Otonashi, along with Monthly Twinkle
and all media who love Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare the commencement
of our new race,
the "Twinkle Star Climax"!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This is a media-driven race organized with the cooperation
of Monthly Twinkle and numerous members of the press!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, we have a comment from a viewer.
Tracen Academy student,
thank you for your question!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super excited for the new race!
What makes a media-driven race so amazing compared to normal ones?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A wonderful question! Well, some might think it arrogant of me to put it this way, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Allow me to say this boldly! The Twinkle Star Climax is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This is a race to decide
the "strongest" Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that is merely "one definition of the strongest"
as far as we in the media are concerned... that is.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone watching this program—
what kind of Umamusume comes to mind
when you hear the word 'strongest'?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Brian?
Did something catch your interest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Who knows. Depends on what we discuss next.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Will she become a Derby Umamusume?
Or a Triple Crown Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Is it an Umamusume who has never lost a single race?
Or is it one who has continued running at the top level longer than anyone else?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
—This time, we have defined the "strongest"
as "the most consistently strong Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "The most consistently strong"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Take, for example, a once-in-a-lifetime race
such as the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Setting your sights on that 'single moment,'
putting everything on the line to hone yourself, and seizing victory with even luck on your side.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...That too is unmistakably
one form of being the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Still, luck plays a part in a single race.
Of course, there are no "what-ifs" in competition, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If only we could run that race just once more.
I am sure many of you have thought the same at least once.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed.
I have too. That is precisely why!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The "Twinkle Star Climax" will adopt a point-based system!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Specially selected top-tier Umamusume will run
three races under identical conditions...
competing for points awarded based on their finishing positions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In addition, our races cover Short, Mile,
Medium, Long, and Dirt...
We offer every single category imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, what this race demands more than anything...
is consistent, reliable "strength" that can
place near the top time and time again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy... This really is
one heck of a race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I aim for the races Oguri is in,
the rest of the lineup won't be identical, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So you'll target me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was just an analogy, dammit!
Don't go gettin' all teary-eyed over weird stuff!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What I wanted to say was,
in this race, you'll be able to do things you never could before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
That means we can throw three wrap-up parties.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell no! Quit makin' me play the straight man every damn time!
...We can formulate a rock-solid 'counterstrategy.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After the first race, everyone knows the pace and how each other fights.
That's why there are fewer and fewer openings left.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Luck won't matter here, and neither will bluffing.
It's a pure contest of raw strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it'll prove who's the strongest"... huh?
I see, that's Tama for you. Simple and clear.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The reporters are pretty much saying the same thing too,
so there's probably no mistaking it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Therefore,
it becomes a contest of pure baseline strength, eliminating elements of luck as much as possible."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you were sayin' the exact same thing the whole time?!
What was even the point of my commentary, then?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
“...To everyone across Japan,
allow me to ask once more.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to decide
who is the "strongest"?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Massive publicity unlike ever before!
More broadcast cameras than ever before!
An overwhelmingly grand race the likes of which has never been seen!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to find out
who the "strongest" Umamusume is?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoh...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tremendous cheers erupted right there on the street.
It was a moment when everyone was dreaming
upon the word 'strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzt! Bzzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Trainer! Did you see the broadcast?!
Please return to the academy immediately!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having rushed over to the Director's Office, from what I heard from Chairwoman Akikawa and Tazuna-san—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...And so, we at Tracen Academy have decided to give our full cooperation to hosting that race!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"That said, cooperation is simple! Yet fiercely difficult!
If you continue to display lion-like valor in the Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An invitation to the
Twinkle Star Climax
will be arriving eventually!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together
so we can run in the race, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Twinkle Star Climax"...
She asked us to push even harder to help hype up this monumental race of the century!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Do you have a moment right now?
choice_data_list: Yes... Ah, from the broadcast earlier!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching!
My name is Otonashi, a reporter for Monthly Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy has provided tremendous
cooperation for this occasion...
Allow me to express my gratitude as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"And as a potential candidate for the Twinkle Star Climax!
We're taking the liberty of placing great expectations on you!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've heard Trainer <username>
is an up-and-coming talent who carries
all of Chairwoman Akikawa's expectations?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, heading into the battle to decide the 'Strongest',
please give us a few words!!
choice_data_list: I-I'll do my very best with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Magnificent!!
Giving it her all until her muscle fibers tear, fully resolved to present her partner with the title of the 'Strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I was moved to the point of losing all composure!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I definitely have to write an article about this...!
choice_data_list: (Th-This has turned into a real disaster...!)
(Th-Things have gotten totally out of hand!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, running in the
Twinkle Star Climax is without a doubt an immense honor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If becoming the "strongest" lies beyond <chrname>'s dream...
then taking on the challenge might just be worth it!
